Name: Shark-Girl
Description: One of the first mutants to emerge post AVX, Iara dos Santos lived in Brazil when her mutant powers kicked in. She suddenly had an amazing graving for fish, and went to the doks to eat the fish some illigela fisherman had just brought in. When the fisherman attacked Iara, she changed the shape of her hands into claws. Her mouth became something like that of a sharkmouth. She was found by Warren Worthington, the Angel, whom, after a fight against Mystique and Silver Samuarai, eventually convinced her to be recruited to the Jean Grey School.
